# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.5 Module 16.5-C: Colonial Independence Contagion & Gunpowder Empires Modernization Crisis (oe_dec_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v165_finance_twilight.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_twilight_of_empires = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_twilight_of_empires

	can_start = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_sit_started }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_sit_ended }
		current_year >= 1750
		current_year <= 1836
		OR = {
			any_colonial_country = { count >= 1 }
			country_exists = c:TUR
			country_exists = c:IRA
			country_exists = c:MUG
			country_exists = c:DLH
			country_exists = c:MCH
			country_exists = c:CHI
			country_exists = c:MNG
			country_exists = c:MAM
			country_exists = c:EGY
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
	}

	# Outcome 1: Reformist Imperial Survival
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_reform"
		desc = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_reform_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_dec_sit_outcome_reform_ready = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_ended value = 1 }
			oe_dec_sit_resolve_reform = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Wave of Sovereign Republics
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_republics"
		desc = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_republics_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_dec_sit_outcome_republics_ready = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_ended value = 2 }
			oe_dec_sit_resolve_republics = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Multipolar Concert Settlement
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_concert"
		desc = "oe_sit_twilight_of_empires_concert_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_dec_sit_outcome_concert_ready = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_ended value = 3 }
			oe_dec_sit_resolve_concert = yes
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_started value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_months value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score value = 30 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave value = 35 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance value = 35 }
		oe_dec_sit_on_start = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_sit_months }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_months add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_sit_months value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					current_month = 1
					current_month = 7
				}
			}
			oe_dec_sit_biannual_sync = yes
		}
	}

	on_ended = { }

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_dec_map_colony_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { is_colonial_overlord = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_dec_map_overlord_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_dec_is_gunpowder_empire = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_dec_map_gunpowder_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_dec_is_maritime_power = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_dec_map_great_power_tt
		}
	}

	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { is_colonial_overlord = yes }
			}
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_dec_is_gunpowder_empire = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_dec_is_maritime_power = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
}
